agenda.title: DISCUSSION AND INFORMATION ITEMS
agenda.note: This is an opportunity to provide information to the City Council. These items are for information only and do not require action by the City Council.

items.title: MAP Funding Capacity and Tier Prioritization
items.plain: The council will discuss how much money is available for MAP funding and how to rank items into priority tiers.

items.title: Alternative Energy Overlay Zone Revisions
items.plain: The council will discuss changes to the alternative energy overlay zone, a special zoning layer for alternative energy uses.

items.title: Corrigan Farms Development Agreement
items.plain: The council will discuss the Corrigan Farms development agreement.

agenda.title: CITY MANAGER INFORMATION ITEMS
agenda.note: This is an opportunity for the City Manager to provide information to the City Council.

agenda.title: AGENDA REVIEW
agenda.note: The City Council will review items on the Consent Agenda and Policy Session Agenda.

agenda.title: ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
agenda.note: The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

agenda.title: PUBLIC COMMENTS
agenda.note: Time has been set aside for the public to express their ideas, concerns, and comments. (Please limit your comments to three minutes each.)

agenda.title: CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR ITEMS

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Corrigan Farms
items.background: (Presented by Senior Planner, David Stroud) Corrigan Farms LLC seeks to rezone parcel number 59:068:0006 to add the RTI overlay zone to the property to allow it to potentially develop a data center project with a natural gas power plant.
items.plain: The council will decide whether to rezone a Corrigan Farms parcel so it could potentially be developed as a data center with a natural gas power plant.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the Corrigan Farms Development Agreement
items.background: (Presented by City Attorney, Marcus Draper) The proposed agreement accompanies the rezone of a 41-acre parcel owned by Corrigan Farms LLC to the RTI Overlay Zone and establishes development and infrastructure requirements for the anticipated data center project. Corrigan Farms LLC owns a 41 acre parcel in the southern portion of our City. The parcel abuts other data center properties, as well as ENYO Energy properties. This agreement was prepared in conjunction with the rezone application for the parcel to the RTI overlay zone. It is consistent with other data center development agreements, except that it is for 20 years instead of 40. It is anticipated that the applicant will construct 2 data centers with an on site natural gas power plant. Article V of the agreement governs the infrastructure requirements to insure success of the project. The language recognizes that there are still unknowns regarding the specifics and maintains flexibility while insuring that the City has the final say. The Development Agreement came before the Council for consideration on October 6th. The Council gave feedback related to concerns that it had for the development. Changes have been made to the agreement to account for the feedback. The matter is on for discussion to make sure that the changes address the previously raised concerns.
items.plain: The council will take up the revised 20-year agreement for two expected data centers and a gas power plant on Corrigan Farms' 41 acres, changed after its 6 October feedback.

items.title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process for a Portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108, Designated as "Significant Real Property" Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060
items.background: (Presented by City Recorder Lacie A. Messerly) This item is a request to dispose of a portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108 designated as “Significant Real Property” in accordance with EMMC 3.30.060. The application, submitted by Allen Barney and various residents pertains to approximately .85 acre (37,026 sq/ft) of property located at Eagle Park Phase I.
items.plain: The council will decide whether to begin public notice and a hearing on residents' request that the city give up about 0.85 acre at Eagle Park.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.25.040 Application, 17.10.030 Definitions, and 17.60.040 General Landscape Provisions
items.background: (Presented by Long Range Planner, Elizabeth Fewkes) A proposal to identify wildland urban interface (WUI) lots on final plats, permit vegetation removal allowances required by Utah Code, and add associated definitions.
items.plain: The council will hold a public hearing on marking lots next to wildland on final subdivision maps and allowing the vegetation clearing state law requires.

items.title: Legislative Priorities List
items.plain: The council will receive an update on its list of legislative priorities.
